description: The largest commercial mortgage a property supports under a lender type's loan-to-value, DSCR and debt-yield limits, which test binds, the monthly payment, and the resulting LTV, DSCR, debt yield and cap rate. Same math and defaults as the site's loan sizer; omit lender_type to size the deal under all five lender types.

amortization_years.description: Amortization in years; 0 means interest only. Default: the lender type's (25 or 30; debt funds 0).

interest_rate_pct.description: Your note rate in percent, e.g. 6.25. Default: the lender type's index today plus the middle of its published spread range.

lender_type.description: bank, life-company, cmbs, agency (multifamily only) or debt-fund. Omit to compare all five.

max_ltv_pct.description: Override the lender type's maximum loan-to-value, in percent.

min_debt_yield_pct.description: Override the minimum debt yield in percent; 0 turns the debt-yield test off.

min_dscr.description: Override the minimum debt service coverage ratio, e.g. 1.25.

noi.description: Annual net operating income in dollars, e.g. 350000.

property_value.description: Property value or purchase price in dollars, e.g. 5000000.

requested_loan.description: Optional loan amount you want, in dollars; the answer says whether it fits.

name: size_loan
title: Size a commercial mortgage
